recovery_code.enter_instructions: Enter your saved recovery code to choose a new PIN and keep your conversations.
recovery_code.not_enrolled: This profile has no active recovery code. Use your previous PIN or a system recovery method you set up earlier. Your conversations are kept.
recovery_code.confirm_pin_instructions: Confirm your app PIN to create a recovery code. A previous code stays valid until you confirm its replacement.
recovery_code.save_instructions: Shown once. Anyone with this code can replace your PIN. Save it separately, then repeat it below. Each code works once and cannot restore a lost conversation key. Your previous code stays valid until you confirm this one.
recovery_code.clipboard_notice: Clipboard history may keep a copy.
recovery_code.verified_notice: Code verified. Choose a new PIN. Your conversations are kept.
recovery_code.saved_notice: Your recovery code is ready. Keep it separately from Tokenlogue.
recovery_code.cancelled_notice: Recovery cancelled. Your PIN and conversations are kept.
